$comment: Ideas Takao believes in. Each one should be able to point at evidence. Lenses reference these by id in an 'exploring' section.

statement.en: I like the beginning of things.

theses.body: New ideas. New technologies. New behaviors. New possibilities. I am strongest when the answer is not obvious yet.
Prototypes, experiments, interactive pieces, tools and ventures are not the output of thinking. They are how the thinking happens.

statement.jp: 媒体は違っても、勘は同じ。

theses.body: A brand film, a festival, a design system in code and an agent fleet look unrelated. They are the same move: find the real question, make it tangible, let people react.

statement.en: Human × AI: fix the architecture first.
statement.jp: 人 × AI：まず構造を直す。

theses.body: AI amplifies whatever architecture it lands on. If knowledge is fragmented, AI returns fragmented answers faster. The design work is upstream of the model.

statement.en: Agentic UX starts from intent, not from the screen.
statement.jp: Agentic UX は画面ではなく意図から始まる。

theses.body: AI knows what you asked. It doesn't know what you need. A product that reads physical state, cognitive load and how much autonomy someone wants is a different kind of product.
